title:
Comment of Tonia Blumer in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/2/2026

documents.name: 151996.txt
documents.text:
Tonia Blumer, Sterling, AK.
As a full time Kenai peninsula resident who heavily relies on salmon for my diet,  I am writing to say that an underwater data center in Cook Inlet should absolutely not happen. Small increases of temperature change can impact salmon and the underwater data centers can cause an increase of 1 degree.  Underwater noise can impact swimming depth and movement patterns and their ability to hunt prey We are already having problems with our king salmon returning. I and many others that live here are against this data center in Cook Inlet. 

thank you for your time.
